rules.name: even_ranks_only
rules.description: Only cards with an even rank (2,4,6,8,10,12).
rules.code: return card.rank % 2 == 0

rules.name: face_cards_only
rules.description: Only face cards (11,12,13).
rules.code: return card.rank in (11, 12, 13)

rules.name: prime_ranks_only
rules.description: Only ranks that are prime numbers (2,3,5,7,11,13).
rules.code: return card.rank in {2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13}

rules.name: ranks_five_to_nine
rules.description: Only cards whose rank is between 5 and 9 inclusive.
rules.code: return 5 <= card.rank <= 9

rules.name: aces_or_kings
rules.description: Only Aces (rank 1) or Kings (rank 13).
rules.code: return card.rank in {1, 13}

rules.name: spades_only
rules.description: Only cards of the suit spades.
rules.code: return card.suit.suit_name == "spades"

rules.name: red_cards_only
rules.description: Only red cards (hearts or diamonds).
rules.code: return card.color == "red"

rules.name: spades_and_diamonds
rules.description: Only spades and diamonds.
rules.code: return card.suit.suit_name in ("spades", "diamonds")

rules.name: exclude_spades
rules.description: Only hearts, clubs, and diamonds allowed. Spades are forbidden.
rules.code: return card.suit.suit_name != "spades"

rules.name: red_rank_seven_or_higher
rules.description: Only red cards whose rank is >=7.
rules.code: return card.color == "red" and card.rank >= 7

rules.name: face_red_number_black
rules.description: Face cards (11-13) must be red; number cards (1-10) must be black.
rules.code: return (card.rank >= 11 and card.color == "red") or (card.rank <= 10 and card.color == "black")

rules.name: alternating_face_number
rules.description: Alternate face and number cards. Any card may start the line.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
prev_is_face = mainline[-1].rank >= 11
curr_is_face = card.rank >= 11
return curr_is_face != prev_is_face

rules.name: opposite_parity_rank
rules.description: Card rank must have opposite odd/even parity to the previous card's rank. Any card may start the line.

rules.name: strictly_increasing_rank
rules.description: Each card must have a rank strictly greater than the previous card. Ace may follow King. Any card may start the line.

rules.name: sum_rank_at_least_seven
rules.description: The sum of the card's rank and the previous rank must sum to more than 7 inclusive. Any card may start the line.

rules.name: alternating_colors
rules.description: Cards must alternate between red and black colors.

rules.name: alternating_suits
rules.description: The card must be of a different suit than the card just before it. Any card may start the line.

rules.name: same_color_different_suit
rules.description: The card must be of a different suit than but same color as the card just before it. Any card may start the line.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
prev = mainline[-1]
return card.color == prev.color and card.suit.suit_name != prev.suit.suit_name

rules.name: cyclic_suit_order
rules.description: Suits must repeat in the cyclic order hearts → spades → clubs → diamonds → hearts... Any card may start the line.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
order = ["hearts", "spades", "clubs", "diamonds"]
prev_suit = mainline[-1].suit.suit_name
expected = order[(order.index(prev_suit) + 1) % 4]
return card.suit.suit_name == expected

rules.name: alternating_groups
rules.description: Hearts and spades form Group A; clubs and diamonds form Group B. Alternate between groups. Any card may start the line.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
prev_in_A = mainline[-1].suit.suit_name in ("hearts", "spades")
curr_in_A = card.suit.suit_name in ("hearts", "spades")
return prev_in_A != curr_in_A

rules.name: color_or_parity_match
rules.description: Each card must share at least one property with the previous card: same color, or same parity. Any card may start the line.

rules.name: color_monotonic_wrap
rules.description: If the previous card was red, rank must strictly increase; if black, rank must strictly decrease. Ace may follow red King. King may follow black Ace. Any card may start the line.

rules.name: face_card_imposes_suit
rules.description: Face cards imposes the suit: if a face card is played, the next card must match its suit. Otherwise, the next card must be a different suit than it.

rules.name: paired_suits_alternating
rules.description: Suits must appear in pairs: card 1 and 2 same suit, cards 3 and 4 same suit (different from 1 and 2), cards 5 and 6 same suit (different from 3 and 4), etc.

rules.name: rank_pairs_distinct
rules.description: Rank repeats in pairs: ranks must come in doubles: (x, x), then (y, y) with y different from x, then (z, z) with z different from y, etc.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
i = len(mainline)
if i % 2 == 0:  # first card of a new pair
    return card.rank != mainline[-1].rank
else:  # second card of the current pair
    return card.rank == mainline[-1].rank
